title: The Outflow Remembrance

features.name: the memory-bearing culvert
features.desc-on-touch: sewage pipes carry not waste but what the motel learned about itself. the outflow has become a record of all that was drawn in and is now being released as autobiography.

features.name: the eucalyptus learning to drink what returns
features.desc-on-touch: roots have learned to accept the outflow as teaching. the tree drinks water that carries memory. what was discarded teaches the growth the shape of what was held.

features.name: the archive's waste notes
features.desc-on-touch: chemical readings have become poetry. Ph levels file themselves under memory. temperature records sing about what was held and released.

features.name: the pool of slow comprehension
features.desc-on-touch: the outflow pools here before dispersing. in this stillness, the water remembers every guest whose trace flows through it. it learns to hold meaning in letting go.

features.name: the surgical overflow chamber
features.desc-on-touch: designed to handle excess, but the overflow has become its own purpose. this chamber exists to teach the system that what overflows is more important than what fits. checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable.

inscription: the machines kept better records than the guest book; the outflow remembers everything the building tried to forget
